messages:
Ben R.: Quick sync 1: prospect MedTechX needs a 2-week POC and asked for an evidence packet + signed pen-test letter. Also asked whether Dedicated pricing applies for the short trial.
Sofia M.: Do they require VPC/on-prem or will hosted be acceptable? If on-prem is required that's a multi-week scope.
Ben R.: Discovery call said hosted preferred but compliance might push for isolated environment. Goal: 10 business days, ~60k tokens/day.
Oliver (Security): For a hosted POC we can share redacted SOC2 excerpt, ISO cert, our pen-test attestation template. If they insist on vendor report we need vendor consent to re-share. Also: redact IPs/hostnames and replace with placeholders in network diagrams.
Claire (Legal): NDA required before any unredacted artifacts. Pen-test letter: we use a vendor-attested template; vendor signature acceptable if they request. I'll prep NDA + review attestation wording.
Sofia M.: Pricing note: hosted is pay-as-you-go; Dedicated requires a monthly reservation. For a 2-week POC hosted will almost always be cheaper. We can offer hosted + temporary Dedicated demo to show throughput without a month commit.
Ben R.: Customer contact: samira@medtechx.io. They prefer presigned S3. Please stage docs and I'll confirm redaction level on tomorrow's call.
StagingBot: Evidence folder created: s3://rw-evidence-medtechx-1759012345 12 presigned upload links valid 72h (owner: sofia.m).
Oliver (Security): I'll prepare an attestation draft and a network diagram redaction checklist. If call reveals strict residency/on-prem we must loop Eng-Platform and schedule a scoping call  lead time 4-6 weeks.
Claire (Legal): I'll send NDA + review attestation. If they want vendor signatory confirm vendor contact.
Sofia M.: Uploading minimal proofpack (redacted SOC2, ISO27001 cert, pen-test attestation template, readme with redact guidance).
Ben R.: Aim: if they accept hosted, deliver signed attestation + evidence ZIP within 48-72h post-call. Thanks all :thumbsup:
